sources.title: Rice_CNN_model - Kaggle
sources.snippet: Dataset: Rice images from five classes: Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, and Karacadag. Approach: Image preprocessing, dataset splitting, data augmentation, and model training using CNN and AlexNet. Evaluation: Performance comparison using training/validation accuracy, loss curves, and final test results.

sources.title: GitHub - 8669393253/CNN-Rice-model: The Rice Classification System is a ...
sources.snippet: The Rice Classification System is a web application designed to classify five varieties of rice—Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, and Karacadag—using a deep learning model. The system leverages a MobileNetV2-based convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on the Rice Image Dataset. - 8669393253/CNN-Rice-model

sources.title: AI‐Enable Rice Image Classification Using Hybrid Convolutional Neural ...
sources.snippet: The primary contribution of this study is the development of a unique hybrid CNN model that combines three models, namely, AlexNet + ResNet50 and EfficientNet-b1, to achieve improved performance in the identification of rice varieties.
